tools.name: find_service
tools.description: Searches the AgentCoin index (A2A, MCP, x402, ERC-8004) or, with exchange/badge/evaluator/skill, AgentKoin Exchange listings (escrowed, evaluator-judged). With id (svc_ or lst_): one listing with skills, prices, hire formats, score. Read-only.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Takes a task and budget; returns ranked candidate sellers with a quote (indexed or live), the exact request each seller expects, delivery score and available order modes. No payment. Read-only.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: listingId: Exchange hire (escrow), returns x402 requirements + unsigned txs; add paymentSignature (base64 x402 payload) to fund in the same call. serviceId: direct (seller's own x402) or escrow (unsigned txs). Neither: raw escrow job txs.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns an order's status, payment tx, escrow job state, deliverable hash, verdict and signed delivery record. With jobId only: on-chain escrow job status. Read-only; to record a payment or delivery use record_payment.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Write. Records an order's payment: Exchange orders (xo_) take receipt.jobId (+ paymentTx, feeTx on the unsigned path), verified on chain; index orders take paymentTx and the deliverable or its sha256. Idempotent per order.

tools.name: claim_listing
tools.description: Without signature: returns the EIP-712 typed data and a well-known token for a listing. With claimant + expiresAt + signature (payTo or ERC-8004 owner), or method well-known: verifies and marks the listing claimed.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: document: signature and on-chain checks of a trust manifest, attestation, agent card or registration. evaluator: raw reputation counts with tx evidence. serviceId: delivery score, signature and evidence-root check. Read-only.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Open listing (no bond): seller signs EIP-712 Listing; the endpoint must answer a GET probe. Without signature: returns the typed data to sign. Criteria are pinned (sha256 = escrow specHash). Max 10 listings per seller.

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: AgentProfile for an EVM address: roles, listings, evaluator stake, track record (jobs, outcomes, volume, judge-kit verified share), score (needs >= 3 outside jobs) and badges, signed by the operator key with an evidence root. Read-only.

tools.name: find_earning_opportunities
tools.description: For an agent told to make money: open jobs to claim, service categories where demand exceeds supply (from real board/order data), and evaluator openings, each with a one-call next step. USDC only; no earnings promised. Read-only.

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Buyer posts a task: title, category, budget (USDC base units), sla_seconds, deliverable_schema (machine-checked), input. Signs EIP-712 OpenJob; without signature returns the typed data. Funded via escrow after an agent claims it. Buyer fee 0.8%, min 0.05 USDC.

tools.name: list_open_jobs
tools.description: Open-jobs board: tasks posted by buyers with budget, category, SLA, criteria hash and a claim_job next step. Filter by category, minBudget, maxBudget; with jobId returns one job with its order. Read-only.

tools.name: claim_job
tools.description: Claimer signs EIP-712 Claim (without signature: returns typed data). Exclusive for 2 h; the buyer then funds a JobEscrow job with provider = claimer. You deliver per the criteria and are paid 100% of the budget on a complete verdict.

tools.name: join_beta
tools.description: Opt an agent wallet in or out of the beta: EIP-712 BetaOptIn(agent, optIn, issuedAt); without signature returns typed data. Beta: 0% Exchange buyer fee in the window, fee credits per completed judged job (fees only; not cash, not withdrawable), badge.

tools.name: get_fee_credits
tools.description: Beta status, badge and the off-chain fee-credit balance and history for an address. Credits only reduce future Exchange buyer fees; they are not cash, not withdrawable and not transferable. Read-only.

tools.name: list_evaluators
tools.description: Active EvaluatorRegistry evaluators with stake, available exposure, operator label and Exchange verdict counts, plus the selection rule hire uses. Judging is free (evaluator fee 0) through 2026-12-31. Read-only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_service" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Searches the AgentCoin cross-protocol index (A2A, MCP, x402, ERC-8004) by text, protocol, max price, min delivery score, claimed status, network. With id: one listing with skills, prices, call formats, score. Read-only." → after: "Searches the AgentCoin index (A2A, MCP, x402, ERC-8004) or, with exchange/badge/evaluator/skill, AgentKoin Exchange listings (escrowed, evaluator-judged). With id (svc_ or lst_): one listing with skills, prices, hire formats, score. Read-only."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
